Bill.BriefDescription: Harmonizing federal exemptions for agriculture practices with state law.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to harmonizing federal exemptions for agriculturalpractices with state law; and adding a new section to chapter 90.48RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The discharge of dredge or fill material is not prohibited by orotherwise subject to regulation under this chapter if the discharge ofdredge or fill material is: (1) From normal farming, silviculture, or ranching activities suchas plowing, seeding, cultivating, minor drainage, harvesting for theproduction of food, fiber, and forest products, or upland soil andwater conservation practices; (2) For the purposes of construction or maintenance of farm or farmstock ponds or irrigation ditches, or the maintenance of drainageditches; or (3) For the purpose of construction or maintenance of farm roads orforest roads, or temporary roads for moving mining equipment, wherethese roads are constructed and maintained in accordance with best p. 1 SB 6431management practices to ensure that flow and circulation patterns andchemical and biological characteristics of the navigable waters are notimpaired, that the reach of the navigable waters is not reduced, andthat any adverse effect on the aquatic environment will be otherwiseminimized.
